description: The Ruby binding's specs of lago-expression (github.com/getlago/lago-expression) at 2abd2b3, the revision lago-api v1.55.0 pins (Gemfile:124), run against the WASM module. A number property is the Ruby Numeric the spec passes; its event is Lago::Event.new("code", 1234, {...}).

cases.name: parse returns an expression when it is valid
parse returns nil when it is not valid
validate returns nil when it is valid
validate returns an error naming the input and what was expected
a simple math expression returns a bigdecimal
a missing property raises an error

cases.note: Not in lago-expression at 2abd2b3, the revision lago-api v1.55.0 pins (Gemfile:124), where dividing by zero panics in BigDecimal (expression-core/src/evaluate.rs, Operation::Divide) and takes the host down. Tanvo returns the error that upstream added in 6a70c6d (parity §4); the case is the spec 6a70c6d added (expression_spec.rb:32).
cases.name: dividing by zero raises an error instead of crashing

cases.note: Not in lago-expression at 2abd2b3, the revision lago-api v1.55.0 pins (Gemfile:124), where dividing by zero panics in BigDecimal (expression-core/src/evaluate.rs, Operation::Divide) and takes the host down. Tanvo returns the error that upstream added in 6a70c6d (parity §4); the case is the spec 6a70c6d added (expression_spec.rb:32).
cases.name: dividing by zero inside a function raises an error instead of crashing
a property that is not a finite number raises an error instead of crashing
cases.note: Not in lago-expression at 2abd2b3 (Gemfile:124), where the Ruby binding panics on a property that is not a finite number (expression-ruby/ext/lago_expression/src/lib.rs, expect on the BigDecimal parse); Tanvo fails as upstream does since 6a70c6d (expression_spec.rb:39 there). Ruby raises when it builds the event; here the event's evaluation fails.

error.message: Failed to parse a number as bigdecimal

cases.name: a simple string expression returns a string
a math expression with a decimal value from the event
a string expression with a decimal value from the event
a decimal expression with decimal values from the event
a property that is neither a number nor a string evaluates to its text
cases.note: The Ruby binding turns a value that is not Numeric into text (Dummy#to_s returns an Integer, so Ruby falls back to its default #<Dummy:0x...>), and the spec checks only that the result is not nil. Tanvo's evaluator takes text and numbers; its hosts convert other JSON values to text first (lago_api.json, evaluate_expression_service.rb:26).

cases.name: concat concatenates the strings
round with negative digits rounds the property to tens
least with the property value higher
least with the property value lower
greatest with the property value higher
greatest with the property value lower
